external_supervisor_contract.ownership: Separately reviewed Windows supervisor must provision and verify owner-private ACLs and reject redirected ancestors before any read/write.
external_supervisor_contract.process_tree: Assign waiting child to owned Windows Job before releasing native command; bounded timeout and termination of residual descendants. Reuse reviewed process_supervisor.py SHA256 7cec5afad989b2d85d969f3653621974f46edf989088407a711166538a25e057.
external_supervisor_contract.completion: Require zero native exit, no timeout, fresh matching run id/timestamps, exact ordered complete case/function/source/control identities, all case statuses PASS, matching source hashes before/after, and unchanged externally pinned manifest/test files.
external_supervisor_contract.failure: Nonzero, timeout, crash, missing/reused/mismatched/non-PASS receipt, source drift or incomplete identity lists is failure. No receipt required after kill.
external_supervisor_contract.bundled_launcher: None. Draft launcher is excluded and unsafe to use as-is.
